shared_elements: elements arranged in loose horizontal rows or bands
justification: The main overlap is only generic: both surfaces include schematic carved-looking geometric marks such as rounded/circular and box-like forms, with some tendency toward horizontal grouping. The biggest difference is that B presents a dense figurative register system with recognizable animals, patterned bands, and interacting forms, while A appears mostly as sparse, weathered abstract glyph-like signs without the same animal iconography or structured scene.
